referenceName: Dapper Dental: high-contrast typographic practice story

source.name: Dapper Dental official website
source.rightsEvidence: Requester attestation on 2026-09-25 permits persistent desktop/mobile screenshots and use as pipeline-model visual reference. No owner license or grant file was uploaded; see rights/requester-attestation.md.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct site uses a compact dark brand bar, a full-width dental-interior hero with bold outlined/filled display lettering, and a long sequence of asymmetrical dark chapters. Short typographic statements alternate with wide photographs and compact explanatory copy; later chapters present patient comfort, services, testimonials/social links, and a distinct booking/location close. Mobile stacks those chapters and reduces display type. The page is the official website of a real Winter Park practice; its exact brand, photos, copy, people, reviews, amenities, and business claims are reference-only.

heroGeometry.mode: full-bleed practice photograph with oversized outlined statement and compact brand bar
heroGeometry.alignment: centered headline over image with dark overlay
heroGeometry.viewport: hero headline, short location/service line, and booking action visible at opening

navigationGeometry.mode: compact dark utility header with brand and quick actions
navigationGeometry.placement: top edge over or just above the hero
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact menu control and quick contact/booking actions

typography.scale: very large display phrases with small utility labels and short supporting paragraphs

palette.contrastIntent: strong high-contrast headline against dark photographic fields

imageTreatment.mode: broad practice and patient-experience photos interleaved with dark statement chapters
imageTreatment.crop: full-width desktop bands and subject-safe mobile images
imageTreatment.focalPoint: retain face and dental context, keep text areas unbusy

servicePresentation.pattern: service and experience chapters introduced by oversized type and concise copy
servicePresentation.interaction: contextual in-page links advance to service/contact details

ctaPlacement.primary: compact top booking action and hero action
ctaPlacement.early: visible at the top and repeated at the final booking close

motion.primitive: subtle scroll reveal and broad image transitions
motion.library: observed source behavior only; do not import source scripts
motion.reducedMotion: show each chapter statically and remove parallax/reveal delay

rules: scale display type while preserving outline/solid hierarchy

prohibitedPatterns: copying source provider identity, copy, photos or patient reviews
fabricated credentials, amenities, awards, prices or pain-free claims

requiredSignatureElements.description: full-bleed image stage with bold outlined or dual-weight display type
alternating text and photo chapters on a deep surface
compact patient/experience details, not an oversized generic about essay

acceptanceChecks: The hero uses a high-impact photo and type hierarchy but carries only verified local client facts.
Sections alternate between bold statement fields and photographic practice chapters rather than repetitive cards.
Services, FAQs, and Contact remain distinct, navigable content areas in the new client page.
At 390 px display type, images, nav, and CTAs fit without horizontal overflow or overlap.
No source brand, photograph, testimonial, staff identity, amenity, or business claim is reused as client fact.

review.notes: Direct page screenshots verified at 1440 and 390. No width overflow. Several source image nodes had empty src values and its story iframe returned an anti-bot/security restriction; these are disclosed. User-attested permission, no owner grant file.
